statements.notes: Warning: Keep out of reach of children.
Inform a healthcare professional before starting any dietary supplement, particularly if there is a known immune-compromised condition.

If your infant develops an allergic reaction such as a rash, itching, wheezing or hives, discontinue use and call your doctor. 
When first taking a probiotic, your baby's gut microbiom adjusts. Your baby may experience minor bloating, gas or intestinal gurgling which should subside with continued use. Consult your healthcare professional if symptoms continue after two weeks.
For questions, concerns or to report an adverse event, please call (800) 722-3476.
Contains none of the following: artificial dyes, preservatives, dairy, sugar, lactose, milk, yeast, soy or gluten.
Storage Instructions: Store Culturelle in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. Guaranteed potency through date on box when stored as directed.
Tamper Evident: Do not use if bottle or dropper appears to be opened.
For children over 1 year: Take Culturelle Baby Grow + Thrive Packets as directed on the package.
